Subject: Private deployment architecture review — next steps & scheduling

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap of the outcomes we agreed on:
- HealthGrid is primarily interested in a VPC/private deployment behind customer-managed networking, with strict KMS integration and audit logging.
- Initial scope: non-PHI workloads now, but you expect to bring PHI in Q4 — you flagged SOC 2 + audit log retention as blockers for timeline.
- Key success criteria for the first phase: predictable latency at 50 req/s, role-based access to models, and a clear ops runbook for incident handoffs.

Next step: technical architecture review (30–45 min) to validate network requirements, KMS approach, and deployment options (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink). Ben (solutions) and Rishi (platform ops) will join from our side to cover kernels/ops and rollout mechanics.

Please pick one of the windows below (I included a Calendly link if easier):
- Thu 23 Mar, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu 23 Mar, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Fri 24 Mar, 09:00–09:45 PT

I attached a short agenda and a network diagram stub to help your infra team prepare (attachment: priv-arch-agenda.pdf, healthgrid-map-network.png).

If those times don't work, tell me your preferred slots and we'll adapt. Also: could you confirm who from your side should receive the ops runbook/architecture diagram afterwards?

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
